_doc: #1405 Cloud Store > Cloud > Ventoy: the catalogue. Every row names its OFFICIAL page (link) and, where an official feed publishes a checksum, the source the app resolves version, URL, size and sha256 from (sums | json | github). A link-only row has no Install. Placement (after_group) is the store's build.json `ventoy` block; test-store-ventoy.sh holds the two equal.
label: Ventoy

tables.label: Linux distros
tables.blurb: Live ISOs Ventoy boots. Version, size and sha256 come from each project's official feed.

rows.name: Ubuntu Desktop LTS
rows.note: Live session, persistence label casper-rw.

rows.name: Fedora Workstation
rows.note: Release feed fedoraproject.org/releases.json (betas skipped).

rows.name: Debian Live (GNOME)
rows.note: Persistence label persistence, with persistence.conf.

rows.name: Arch Linux
rows.note: Persistence label vtoycow.

rows.name: Linux Mint Cinnamon
rows.note: Newest release under pub.linuxmint.io/stable; persistence label casper-rw.

rows.name: openSUSE Tumbleweed
rows.note: Rolling snapshot; the Current alias is checked against its own .sha256.

rows.name: NixOS (graphical)
rows.note: Channel nixos-26.05; the latest alias is checked against its .sha256.

rows.name: Pop!_OS
rows.note: Build feed api.pop-os.org (Intel/AMD image).

rows.name: Kali Linux Live
rows.note: Persistence label persistence, with persistence.conf.

rows.name: Tails
rows.note: Tails keeps its own Persistent Storage; Ventoy persistence does not apply.

tables.label: Android Desktop
tables.blurb: Android for PCs. None publishes a machine-readable feed: download from the official page, then Install a local image.

rows.name: Bliss OS
rows.note: Builds and their sha256 are on blissos.org / SourceForge; no machine-readable feed. Download it, then Install a local image.

rows.name: PrimeOS
rows.note: No machine-readable release feed; link only.

rows.name: FydeOS
rows.note: Per-device images on fydeos.io; link only.

rows.name: Android-x86
rows.note: Last release 9.0-r2; checksums are in its release note. Link only.

rows.name: LineageOS x86
rows.note: LineageOS publishes no official x86 PC ISO; community builds are not listed here.

tables.label: Android Mobile
tables.blurb: Phone builds are device images: flash, not Ventoy.

rows.name: LineageOS
rows.note: Device image: flash, not Ventoy.

rows.name: GrapheneOS
rows.note: Pixel factory image via the web installer: flash, not Ventoy.

rows.name: /e/OS
rows.note: Device image: flash, not Ventoy.

rows.name: CalyxOS
rows.note: Device image: flash, not Ventoy.

tables.label: Customised ISOs
tables.blurb: Tools that build your own image. Install the result with Install a local image.

rows.name: Cubic (Ubuntu remaster)
rows.note: Customise an Ubuntu ISO on a PC, then Install a local image.

rows.name: HashiCorp Packer
rows.note: Packer-built images; copy the ISO/IMG output with Install a local image.

rows.name: NixOS custom ISO
rows.note: nix build of your own configuration's isoImage; then Install a local image.

rows.name: Cloud-init NoCloud seed
rows.note: A cidata seed ISO (user-data + meta-data) is attached next to a cloud image, not booted by Ventoy; build it with cloud-localds, link only.

rows.name: Talos Linux (metal ISO)
rows.note: The default schematic's metal ISO from the Talos release; custom schematics are built on factory.talos.dev.
